Tank In-Combo Mitigation Has Been Overhauled and Moved

entries.Original:
Tanks have had their In-Combo Mitigation completely overhauled.
No longer is their mitigation settings in each combo, and no longer is mitigation entirely triggered by HP%.
Mitigation is now in its own Section, under the Advanced Combos, and those options apply to the Advanced Combos
if they have 'Include Mitigations' checked.
(Simple Modes will use the recommended values for these settings, if 'Include Mitigations' is checked there)

You can find these moved mitigation settings here:
PvE Features > [Tank of choice] > Advanced Mitigation Options

Make sure Mitigation is enabled in combos for these to work:
PvE Features > [Tank of choice] > Advanced/Simple Combo > Include Mitigations
entries.Translated:
坦克的连招内减伤已完全重做。
减伤设置不再位于各连招中，减伤也不再完全由血量百分比触发。
减伤现在位于独立分区，在高级连招下，若勾选“包含减伤”，这些选项将应用于高级连招。
（若在简单模式中勾选“包含减伤”，将使用这些设置的推荐值）

你可以在以下位置找到迁移后的减伤设置：
PvE 功能 > [所选坦克] > 高级减伤选项

请确保在连招中启用减伤，这些设置才会生效：
PvE 功能 > [所选坦克] > 高级/简单连招 > 包含减伤
全屏攻击检测改进，坦克死刑检测新增

entries.Original: Close and Do Not Show again
This section contains a range of bespoke "Custom Actions" which can be used as replacements for either base action replacements or specific macros.
entries.Translated: 本节包含一系列定制的“自定义动作”，可用于替代基础动作替换或特定宏。

entries.Original:
These buttons replace the need to replace actions for all features marked as either Simple or Advanced. Enable the type of combo you're wanting to use custom actions for, and drag the icon to your hotbar.

This frees up the actions for manual use, for example, for downtime where you only want to use 1-2-3 combos, or for healers to always have access to basic healing actions.

这样可以释放动作以供手动使用，例如在只需要使用1-2-3连击的空档期，或让治疗职业始终可以使用基础治疗动作。

entries.Original:
If you see the ID constantly changing, that's a sign that the Retarget is constantly being Partially Overwritten.

This occurs when two different Retargets keep being registered, which do not fully overwrite each other (they do not share the same Replaced Actions).
Usually this is when you have a retargeting of an action in Feature and also in a Main Combo, and is a sign that both/all the Retargets will likely work.
entries.Translated:

当两个不同的重定向不断被注册，且它们没有完全互相覆盖时（它们不共享相同的被替换技能），就会发生这种情况。
通常是你既在功能中又在主连招中对某个技能进行了重定向，这表明两个/所有重定向很可能都会生效。

entries.Translated: 当队伍中有人带有可除垢的减益时，按照队伍列表使用重新选目标功能施放光阴神之诗。

entries.Original: Stop using Buffs on targets below this HP % (0 = always use, 100 = never use).
entries.Translated: 当目标HP低于此百分比时停止使用增益（0 = 始终使用，100 = 从不使用）。

entries.Original: Adds Bloodletter when at max charges
entries.Translated: 在满层数时添加失血箭

entries.Original: Adds Rain of Death when at max charges, or bloodletter below level.
entries.Translated: 满层时加入死亡箭雨，或等级不足时加入失血箭。

entries.Original: Iron Jaws will only show up when debuffs are about to expire.
entries.Translated: 仅在减益即将结束时显示伶牙俐齿。

entries.Original: Adds Apex and Blast Arrow to Iron Jaws when available.
entries.Translated: 可用时将巅峰和爆破箭加入伶牙俐齿。

entries.Original: Also use Pray whenever the buff is missing, not only below the HP threshold.
entries.Translated: 当增益缺失时也使用祈祷，不仅限于低于血量阈值时。

entries.Original: When disabled, prefers the lowest-HP party member under the threshold.
entries.Translated: 禁用时，优先选择低于阈值中血量最低的队伍成员。

entries.Original: Max target distance (yalms) to use Phantom Kick
entries.Translated: 使用踢击的最大目标距离（米）

entries.Original: Self or average party HP % at or below which to use Blessing
entries.Translated: 自身或队伍平均血量百分比低于或等于此值时使用天之恩典

entries.Original: Self or average party HP % at or below which to prioritize Judgment as a heal
entries.Translated: 自身或队伍平均血量百分比低于或等于此值时优先将制裁作为治疗

entries.Original: Use Invulnerability before Starfall when Prediction of Starfall is up.
entries.Translated: 当陨石预言存在时，在落星池前使用不死宣告。

entries.Original: Use Suspend while out of combat.
Only use Occult Toad with 2+ targets in range, or when raidwide damage is incoming.
entries.Translated: 仅在范围内有2个以上目标，或即将受到全屏伤害时使用魔蛙变。

entries.Original: Refresh Occult Libra when remaining time is at or below this many seconds.
entries.Translated: 当剩余时间小于或等于该秒数时，刷新魔侦测。

entries.Original: Blazing Spellblade also refreshes at 30s remaining so other Spellblades do not take its cooldown.
entries.Translated: 魔法剑·核爆在剩余 30 秒时也会刷新，以免其他魔法剑占用其冷却。

entries.Original: When disabled, also triggers if the lowest party member is below the HP threshold.
entries.Translated: 禁用时，若血量最低的队员低于血量阈值也会触发。

entries.Original: When disabled, also triggers if any party member is below the MP threshold.
entries.Translated: 禁用时，若任意队员低于魔力阈值也会触发。

entries.Original: Retarget to Out of Party Players
entries.Translated: 重新选目标至队外玩家

entries.Original: Also retargets if anyone outside your party falls below this HP%
entries.Translated: 若队伍外任意玩家血量低于该百分比也会重新选目标

entries.Original: Use for damage (respects Restrict to Buff).
entries.Translated: 用于输出（遵循限制增益）。

entries.Original: Only when your HP is at or below the heal threshold.
entries.Translated: 仅当自身血量低于或等于治疗阈值时。

entries.Original: Only when your HP is at or below the emergency threshold.
entries.Translated: 仅当自身血量低于或等于紧急阈值时。

entries.Original: Necromancer spells while Drain Touch is active:
entries.Translated: 吸血触生效期间的死灵法师法术：

entries.Original: Cast Deep Freeze / Hell Wind / Chaos Drive / Doomsday only while Drain Touch is down.
entries.Translated: 仅在吸血触未生效时施放深度冻结 / 地狱之风 / 混沌疾雷 / 末日审判。

entries.Original: Cast those spells only during the Drain Touch buff.
entries.Translated: 仅在吸血触增益期间施放这些法术。

entries.Original: Ignore Drain Touch buff for spell usage.
entries.Translated: 施放法术时忽略吸血触增益。
仅在 4 层必杀强化时

entries.Original: Keep Defend for when you have full Finishing Fervor stacks.
entries.Translated: 保留防御，直到必杀强化层数满时使用。

entries.Original: When both Blind and Paralysis can apply:
entries.Translated: 当失明和麻痹均可施加时：
当两者均无法施加时（免疫/已达上限）：

entries.Original: Refresh this buff or debuff when remaining time is at or below this many seconds. 0 waits until it drops.
entries.Translated: 当剩余时间小于或等于该秒数时刷新此增益或减益。0 表示等到其消失。

entries.Original: Anti-Drift Options:     (hover each for more info)
entries.Translated: 防漂移选项：     （悬停查看详情）

entries.Original:
Forces a triple weave of Flourish and Fan Dance 3 + 4 during non-opener burst windows.
Fixes SS/FM drift where you use a gcd when SS/FM is on a 0.5sec CD.
Recommended anti-drift option.
entries.Translated:
在非起手爆发窗口期间强制三插百花争艳和扇舞·序 3 + 4。
修复 SS/FM 漂移，即当 SS/FM 处于 0.5 秒 CD 时使用 GCD。
推荐的防漂移选项。

entries.Original:
Will hold GCDs for Standard Step if it is going to come off cooldown before your next GCD.
This WILL give you down-time.
ONLY recommended if you have extra skill speed, but can be used as an anti-drift option.
entries.Translated:
如果标准舞步将在你的下一个 GCD 之前冷却完毕，则为其保留 GCD。
这会导致你出现空闲时间。
仅在你有多余技能速度时推荐，但也可作为防漂移选项使用。

entries.Original:
Will use both options from above.
This WILL give you down-time.
NOT recommended, but can be the answer if neither of the above options work for you.
entries.Translated:
将同时使用上述两个选项。
这会导致你出现空闲时间。
不推荐，但如果以上选项均不适用于你，这可能是答案。

entries.Original:
Will not use any anti-drift options.
This WILL cause drift. NOT recommended.
entries.Translated:
不使用任何防漂移选项。
这会导致漂移。不推荐。

entries.Original: This will check through your party members, and select the most desirable Partner, based on The Balance's priority list as well as stuff like Rez Sickness and Damage Downs.
entries.Translated: 这将检查你的队员，并根据 The Balance 的优先级列表以及复活虚弱和伤害降低等因素，选择最理想的舞伴。

entries.Original: NO SUPPORT is provided for setting up this feature!
entries.Translated: 不提供任何关于设置此功能的支持！

entries.Original:
You can change the respective actions by inputting action IDs below for each dance step.
The defaults are Cascade, Flourish, Fan Dance, and Fan Dance II.
If set to 0, they will reset to these actions.
(You can get Action IDs with Garland Tools by searching for the action and clicking the cog.)
entries.Translated:
你可以通过在下方为每个舞步输入技能 ID 来更改对应的技能。
默认技能为倾泻、百花争艳、扇舞·序和扇舞·破。
若设为 0，则会重置为这些技能。
（你可以在 Garland Tools 中搜索技能并点击齿轮图标来获取技能 ID。）

entries.Original: This WILL let you set up a conflict!
Double check the actions you are setting do not conflict with other combos you are using, or enable the feature below!
entries.Translated: 请仔细检查你设置的技能是否与你正在使用的其他连招冲突，否则请启用下方功能！

entries.Original: Select what kind of content to use this opener in:
entries.Translated: 选择在何种内容中使用此起手：

entries.Original:
Requires at least a 15s cooldown
and that you start Standard Step at 15s.
entries.Translated:
需要至少 15 秒的冷却时间，
并且你在 15 秒时开始标准舞步。

entries.Original:
Requires at least a 7s cooldown
and that you start Standard Step at 7s.
Performs worse than 15s.
entries.Translated:
需要至少 7 秒的冷却时间，
并且你在 7 秒时开始标准舞步。
表现不如 15 秒。

entries.Original:
Requires a 30s cooldown
and that you start Standard Step at 30s.
Not generally recommended.
Will align buffs worse than Standard 15s.
Not recommended if Standard Step would pull.
entries.Translated:
需要 30 秒的冷却时间，
并且你在 30 秒时开始标准舞步。
通常不推荐。
增益对齐效果不如标准 15 秒。
若标准舞步会开怪则不推荐。

entries.Original:
Requires at least a 7s cooldown.
Does NOT contain Standard Step.
Not generally recommended.
entries.Translated:
需要至少 7 秒的冷却时间。
不包含标准舞步。
通常不推荐。
技巧：7 秒倒计时（备选）

entries.Original: If you have a focus target that is within range, it will be prioritized over The Balance's suggested Dance Partner.
entries.Translated: 如果你有处于范围内的焦点目标，它将优先于 The Balance 建议的舞伴。

entries.Original: If you have a focus target that is within range, alive, and has no rez sickness or damage down, it will be prioritized over The Balance's suggested Dance Partner.
entries.Translated: 如果你有处于范围内、存活且没有复活虚弱或伤害降低的焦点目标，它将优先于 The Balance 建议的舞伴。

entries.Original: Target HP% to stop using Standard Step below
entries.Translated: 目标 HP% 低于此值时停止使用标准舞步

entries.Original:
Will include Standard Step itself,
dance steps, and Finish into the rotation.
entries.Translated:
会将标准舞步本身、
舞步以及结束技纳入循环。

entries.Original:
Will ONLY include the dance steps, and Finish;
YOU will need to manually press Standard Step.
entries.Translated:
仅包含舞步和结束动作；
你需要手动按下标准舞步。

entries.Original: Target HP% to stop using Technical Step below
entries.Translated: 低于此目标血量百分比时停止使用技巧舞步

entries.Original:
Will include Technical Step itself,
dance steps, and Finish into the rotation.
entries.Translated:
将技巧舞步本身、
舞步和结束动作纳入循环。

entries.Original:
Will ONLY include the dance Steps, and Finish;
YOU will need to manually press Technical Step.
entries.Translated:
仅包含舞步和结束动作；
你需要手动按下技巧舞步。

entries.Original: Target HP% to dump all pooled feathers below
entries.Translated: 低于此目标血量百分比时倾泻所有储存的幻扇

entries.Original:
Will use Tillana as recommended by The Balance.
Can allow Tillana to drift out of burst windows.
entries.Translated:
按太阳神之衡的建议使用提拉纳。
可能导致提拉纳偏离爆发窗口。

entries.Original:
Will use Tillana as recommended by The Balance,
but will also use it if about to expire.
Not really recommended.
entries.Translated:
按太阳神之衡的建议使用提拉纳，
但即将过期时也会使用。
不太推荐。

entries.Original:
Will perform Tillana over Saber or Dance of the Dawn, even if above 50 Esprit.
Can prevent Tillana from drifting out of burst windows.
Should be used with Saber Dance's Esprit slider being >50.
NOT recommended. Only for Esprit-Micro-Managers.
entries.Translated:
即使幻扇高于50也会优先使用提拉纳而非剑舞或拂晓舞。
可防止提拉纳偏离爆发窗口。
应与剑舞的幻扇滑块设为>50配合使用。
不推荐。仅适合幻扇微操管理者。
治疗之华尔兹血量百分比

entries.Original:
Will ONLY include the dance steps, and Finish;
YOU will need to manually press Technical Step.
entries.Translated:
仅包含舞步和结束动作；
你需要手动按下技巧舞步。

entries.Original: Action to Show when Partner is Optimal Options:     (hover each for more info)
entries.Translated: 舞伴最优时显示的动作 选项：（悬停查看详情）

entries.Original:
Will not change the action shown in the hotbar from what FFXIV puts there.
When you have a Dance Partner, it will show Ending, as usual.

This is the default behavior.
entries.Translated:
不会改变热键栏中FFXIV显示的动作。
当你拥有舞伴时，会照常显示结束动作。

这是默认行为。

entries.Original:
When your current partner is optimal Closed Position will be shown.
This will block you from using Closed Position or Ending
(unless you hard target a friendly other than your partner)
entries.Translated:
当你的当前舞伴处于最优状态时，将显示闭式舞姿。
这将阻止你使用闭式舞姿或结束
（除非你硬锁定一个非舞伴的友方目标）

entries.Original:
When your current partner is optimal, the input will be blocked.
This will block you from using Closed Position or Ending.

This is the recommended option, to keep you from mistakenly switching partners.
entries.Translated:
当你的当前舞伴处于最优状态时，将阻止输入。
这将阻止你使用闭式舞姿或结束。

这是推荐选项，可防止你误切换舞伴。

entries.Original: Enables the use of mitigations in Simple Mode.
entries.Translated: 在简单模式下启用减伤。

entries.Original: Disables the use of mitigations in Simple Mode.
entries.Translated: 在简单模式下禁用减伤。

entries.Original: Enables the use of advanced mitigations
Disables the use of advanced mitigations
Disables the use of advanced mitigations
HP% to use at or below
entries.Translated: HP% 使用阈值（低于或等于）

entries.Original: Select what difficulties TBN should be used on CD:
entries.Translated: 选择 TBN 应在 CD 上使用的难度：
优先使用暗影墙/暗影卫
在铁壁之前使用暗影墙/暗影卫

entries.Original:
Tries to align Dark Mind with Rampart for tankbusters.
(as it is lesser than Shadow Wall/Shadowed Vigil)
entries.Translated:
尝试将弃明投暗与铁壁对齐用于坦克buster。
（因为它弱于暗影墙/暗影卫）

entries.Original: Front-loads burst to align with an early (1st GCD) party buff window.
entries.Translated: 前置爆发以对齐早期（第1个GCD）的团队增益窗口。

entries.Original:
Will use Unmend to pull, if selected.
Should start at -1.0 seconds.

Recommended by The Balance.
entries.Translated:
如果选中，将使用伤残开怪。
应在 -1.0 秒时开始。

太阳神之衡推荐。

entries.Original:
Will use Shadowstride to pull, if selected.
Should start at -0.7 seconds.
entries.Translated:
如果选中，将使用暗影步开怪。
应在 -0.7 秒时开始。

entries.Original:
Will use Hard Slash to pull, if selected.
Should start at 0.0 seconds.
entries.Translated:
如果选中，将使用重斩开怪。
应在 0.0 秒时开始。

entries.Original: Will use Cooldowns regardless of the type of enemy.
entries.Translated: 无论敌人类型如何，都会使用能力技。

entries.Original:
Will try to use Cooldowns only when you're in a boss fight.
(Note: don't rely on this 100%, square sometimes marks enemies inconsistently)
entries.Translated:
仅在首领战中尝试使用能力技。
（注意：不要完全依赖此选项，Square 有时会不一致地标记敌人）

entries.Original: Select what difficulty the above sliders should apply to:
entries.Translated: 选择上述滑块适用的难度：

entries.Original: Will use Delirium usages on cooldown. Recommended.
entries.Translated: 冷却好了就使用错乱剑。推荐。

entries.Original: Tie to Living Shadow (for manual control)
entries.Translated: 绑定掠影示现（用于手动控制）

entries.Original:
Will require Living Shadow to have been recently used before using even-minute Deliriums.
(Odd-minute Delirium usage will proceed on cooldown)

ONLY recommended if you want more manual control.
(Does not apply to Blood Weapon)
entries.Translated:
在使用偶数分钟的错乱剑之前，需要最近使用过掠影示现。
（奇数分钟的错乱剑会按冷却正常使用）

仅当你想要更多手动控制时推荐。
（不适用于嗜血）

entries.Original:
Will use Salt and Darkness about halfway through Salted Earth's duration, after more important oGCDs.
Recommended.
entries.Translated:
在腐秽大地持续时间过半时使用腐秽黑暗，在更重要的能力技之后。
推荐。
立即使用（用于大量移动）

entries.Original:
Will use Salt and Darkness as soon as possible (outside of the opener).
Only Recommended for heavy movement fights, and only if you know you can fit your other oGCDs in.
entries.Translated:
尽快使用腐秽黑暗（起手式之外）。
仅推荐用于大量移动的战斗，且仅当你确定能塞下其他能力技时。

entries.Original: Mana to always save for TBN (0 = Use All). Spent freely until you have The Blackest Night.
entries.Translated: 为至黑之夜保留的魔力（0 = 全部使用）。在拥有至黑之夜前可自由消耗。

entries.Original: Seconds before Burst to save (allowing capping)
entries.Translated: 爆发前保留的秒数（允许溢出）

entries.Original: Will use Salt and Darkness as soon as possible.
Mana to save for TBN (0 = Use All). Spent freely until you have The Blackest Night.
entries.Translated: 为至黑之夜保留的魔力（0 = 全部使用）。在拥有至黑之夜前可自由消耗。

entries.Original: Select what difficulties Emergency Living Dead should be used in:
entries.Translated: 选择紧急行尸走肉应在哪些难度中使用：

entries.Original: Will not use Dark Missionary unless there are 2 or more party members.
entries.Translated: 除非有 2 名或以上小队成员，否则不会使用暗黑布道。

entries.Original: Will not require a party for Dark Missionary.
Will use Arm's Length regardless of the type of enemy.
entries.Translated: 无论敌人类型如何都会使用亲疏自行。

entries.Original: Will try not to use Arm's Length when in a boss fight.
entries.Translated: 在首领战中会尽量避免使用亲疏自行。

entries.Original: How many enemies should be nearby? (0 = No Requirement)
entries.Translated: 附近应有多少敌人？（0 = 无要求）
暗影墙 / 警戒优先级：

entries.Original:
Note: If you are Off-Tanking, and want to use this ability on yourself, the expectation would be that you do so via the One-Button Mitigation Feature or the Mitigation options in your rotation.
If you don't, it would go to the main tank.
If you don't use those Features for your personal mitigation, you may not want to enable this.
entries.Translated:
注意：如果你是副坦，并希望对自己使用此技能，预期应通过一键减伤功能或循环中的减伤选项来实现。
如果不这样做，它会作用于主坦。
如果你不使用这些功能进行个人减伤，可能不想启用此项。

entries.Original:
Time Remaining on Oblation to allow within
(0 = Oblation must not be on the target)
entries.Translated:
允许献奉剩余时间在
(0 = 目标身上不能有献奉)

entries.Original: Will use Camouflage as extra tankbuster mitigation if under this HP%
entries.Translated: 当 HP 低于此百分比时，将伪装作为额外的坦克buster减伤使用

entries.Original: Tries to align Camouflage with Rampart for tankbusters.
entries.Translated: 尝试将伪装与铁壁对齐以应对坦克buster。
在所有起手循环中正常使用

entries.Original: as soon as possible in all openers
entries.Translated: 在所有起手循环中尽快使用

entries.Original: for at least one usage inside of
entries.Translated: 以在以下期间至少使用一次

entries.Original: Does not hold any charges of

Stop usage if Target HP% is below set value.
 To disable this, set value to 0
entries.Translated:
目标HP%低于设定值时停止使用。
 要禁用此功能，请将值设为0

entries.Original: as the last GCD in burst
entries.Translated: 作为爆发中的最后一个GCD

entries.Original: Select what difficulties Superbolide should be used in:
entries.Translated: 选择超火流星应在哪些难度中使用：

entries.Original: Will not use Heart of Light unless there are 2 or more party members.
entries.Translated: 队伍中少于2名队员时不使用光之心。

entries.Original: Will not require a party for Heart of Light.
Uses cooldowns only when inside a weave window (excludes No Mercy)
entries.Translated: 仅在插入窗口内使用能力技（不含无情）

entries.Original: Uses cooldowns as soon as possible
entries.Translated: 能力技冷却好了就尽快使用

entries.Original: Use this feature as intended on
WARNING: This WILL conflict with 'No Mercy Features'!
entries.Translated: 警告：此设置会与“无情功能”冲突！

entries.Original: procs available as soon as possible

Dynamic choice of combo finisher based on position and available charges.
Go to Flank to build charges, Rear to spend them. 
Prevents overcap or waste and will use true north as needed.
entries.Translated:
根据位置和可用层数动态选择连击必杀。
前往侧身积攒层数，前往背面消耗层数。
防止溢出或浪费，并按需使用真北。

entries.Original: to use Kazematoi when target is below Health %
entries.Translated: 在目标生命值低于 % 时使用风缠

entries.Original: Stop using on targets below this HP % (0% = always use, 100% = never use).
entries.Translated: 停止对生命值低于此 % 的目标使用（0% = 始终使用，100% = 从不使用）。

entries.Original: Will Pool the charges, saving them for Trick Window
entries.Translated: 将留存层数，留待攻其不备窗口使用

entries.Original:
Will Use Raiton when out of Melee range of the target, 
This can negatively affect your burst windows
entries.Translated:
在目标近战范围外时使用雷遁，
这可能会对你的爆发窗口产生负面影响

entries.Original: Set the amount of time remaining on Trick Attack cooldown before trying to set up with Suiton.
entries.Translated: 设置攻其不备冷却剩余时间，以便尝试用水遁进行准备。

entries.Original: Will automatically Fuma Shuriken then Raiton then Suiton
entries.Translated: 将自动依次使用风魔手里剑、雷遁、水遁

resources.Original: Turns Phantom Rush Combo into an all-in-one damage button.
resources.Translated: 将梦幻斗舞连击整合为一个一键输出按钮。

resources.Original: Pools Rain of death charges to allow for optimum burst phases.
resources.Translated: 积攒死亡箭雨层数，以便在最佳爆发期使用。

resources.Original: Adds Pray into the rotation (keep-up and/or HP threshold).
resources.Translated: 将祈祷加入循环（保持和/或血量阈值）。

resources.Original: Retargets Heart of Stone/Corundum to your mouseover target or hard target outside of rotations.
resources.Translated: 在循环之外将石之心/刚玉之心重新指向鼠标指向目标或当前目标。

resources.Original: Use Banner of Solemn Clarity when available.

resources.Translated: 召唤兽技能与召唤特性

resources.Original:
Adds Egi Abilities (Astral Flow) to Egi summons when ready.
Egi abilities will appear on their respective Egi summon ability, as well as Titan.
resources.Translated:
召唤兽技能（星极超流）就绪时加入对应召唤兽召唤中。
召唤兽技能会显示在对应的召唤兽召唤技能上，泰坦亦然。

resources.Original: Replaces Windmill with a full one-button AoE rotation.
resources.Translated: 将风车替换为完整的一键群体循环。

resources.Original: Adds selected buffs to the rotation
resources.Translated: 将选定的增益加入循环

resources.Original: Enable this to add Summoner-specific actions into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 启用后将召唤师专属技能加入循环。

resources.Original:
Includes Improvisation in the AoE rotation when available.
Will not use while under Technical Finish
resources.Translated:
群体循环中即兴表演可用时加入。
技巧舞步结束期间不会使用

resources.Original: Adds Blast Arrow to Burst Mode.
resources.Translated: 将爆破箭加入爆发模式。

resources.Original: Enable this to add Chemist-specific actions into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 启用后会将化学师专属技能加入循环。

resources.Original: Adds Howling Fist / Enlightenment to the rotation
resources.Translated: 将空鸣拳 / 星导山山顶加入循环
空鸣拳 / 星导山山顶选项

resources.Original: Adds Phalanx Combo to Burst Mode.
resources.Translated: 将列阵连击加入爆发模式。
将重力替换为以下选项
高级输出模式 - 群体

resources.Original: Adds Orogeny into the AoE rotation.
resources.Translated: 将地面崩坏加入群体循环。
使用均衡来施放均衡失衡。

resources.Original: Weaves Lucid Dreaming when your MP drops below the specified value.
resources.Translated: 当你的魔力低于指定值时插入醒梦。

resources.Original:
Changes Magick Barrier to Addle when on cooldown. 
Will Display the lowest cooldown skill if both are on cooldown.
resources.Translated:
当抗死处于冷却时改为使用混乱。
若两者都在冷却中，则显示冷却最短的技能。

resources.Original: Adds Feint when Raidwide is detected casting and not in a Mudra.
resources.Translated: 检测到全屏攻击读条且不在忍术状态时加入牵制。

resources.Original: Adds Role Action Smite to Burst Mode below selected health
resources.Translated: 在低于所选血量时，将职能技能重击加入爆发模式

resources.Original: Adds Occult Cure III into the rotation.
Adds Blizzard in Cyan to the combo.
resources.Translated: 将冰结之蓝青加入连击。

resources.Original: Retargets Benefic and Benefic II to the heal stack (even from the Benefic 2 Downgrade Feature above).
resources.Translated: 将吉星和吉星II的目标重新指向治疗堆叠（即使来自上方的吉星2降级功能）。

resources.Original:
Adds (Executioner's) Gibbet and Gallows on Blood Stalk.
Adds (Executioner's) Guillotine on Grim Swathe.
resources.Translated:
在隐匿挥割后加入（绞决）处刑和缢杀。
在束缚挥割后加入（断首）处刑。

resources.Original: Gibbet and Gallows/Guillotine on Blood Stalk/Grim Swathe Feature
resources.Translated: 隐匿挥割/束缚挥割后的处刑和缢杀/断首功能

resources.Original: Includes Finishing Move in the rotation.
Adds Primal Wrath into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将原初的怒震加入循环。

resources.Original: Adds The Blackest Night when below HP threshold and targeted.
resources.Translated: 当血量低于阈值且已选中目标时，加入至黑之夜。

resources.Original: Adds missing Motifs to the combo while out of combat.
resources.Translated: 在战斗外为连击补充缺失的动机。

resources.Original:
Add Corps-a-corps when available for DPS. 
Will retain a charge for gap-closing.
resources.Translated:
在可用时加入短兵相接以提升输出。
会保留一层充能用于突进。

resources.Original: Uses Edge of Darkness if you are at or above 9,400 mana, except when saving for burst.
resources.Translated: 当魔力达到或超过 9,400 时使用暗黑锋，但为爆发预留时除外。

resources.Original:
Includes Devilment in the rotation.
Will activate only during Technical Finish if you're Lv70 or above.
Will be used on cooldown below Lv70.
resources.Translated:
将进攻之探戈纳入循环。
若你达到 70 级或以上，仅在技巧舞步结束期间启动。
70 级以下则冷却好了就用。

resources.Original: Collection of spenders (mana and blood) to add to the rotation.
resources.Translated: 加入循环的消耗技能集合（魔力与暗血）。

resources.Original: Retargets Asylum to yourself (even from the Mitigation Feature above).
resources.Translated: 将庇护所重新指向自己（即使来自上方的减伤功能）。

resources.Original: Turns Dual Fang Combo into an all-in-one button.
resources.Translated: 将双牙连击变为一键整合按钮。
在可用时使用失传推进。
将死星核爆加入爆发模式。

resources.Original:
Adds Ikishoten when at or below 50 Kenki.
PRE 94: Will dump Kenki at 10 seconds left to allow Ikishoten to be used.
POST 94: Will use during burst window.
resources.Translated:
当剑气值小于等于50时使用意气冲天。
94级前：在剩余10秒时倾泻剑气，以便使用意气冲天。
94级后：在爆发窗口内使用。

resources.Original:
Changes Asylum into Temperance and then Divine Caress after use.
Can be Retargeted with the Retargeting Features below.
resources.Translated:
使用后将会把庇护所变为节制，随后变为神爱抚。
可通过下方的重新选目标功能重新选目标。

resources.Original: Weaves Druochole when Addersgall gauge is greater than or equal to the specified value.
resources.Translated: 当蛇胆量规大于等于指定值时插入灵橡清汁。

resources.Original:
Adds the Atonement chain to Advanced Mode.
- Will be prioritized if buff is expiring.
resources.Translated:
将赎罪剑连击加入高级模式。
- 若增益即将结束时将优先使用。
加入泰然自若用于治疗。

resources.Original: Blizzard I to Blizzard IV Feature
Replaces Blizzard I with Blizzard IV when available.
resources.Translated: 当可用时将冰结I替换为冰结IV。

resources.Original: Changes Swiftcast to Verraise when under the effect of Swiftcast or Dualcast.
resources.Translated: 当处于即刻咏唱或连续咏唱效果下时，将即刻咏唱变为赤复活。

resources.Original:
Replaces True Thrust with a full one-button single target rotation.
These features are ideal if you want to customize the rotation.
resources.Translated:
将精准刺替换为完整的单键单体循环。
如果你想自定义循环，这些功能非常理想。
当可用时使用失传护盾。

resources.Original: Adds Leg Sweep when target non-boss is casting.
resources.Translated: 当非首领目标正在咏唱时使用扫堂枪。

resources.Original: Adds Occult Raise into the rotation, retargeted to your Raise Stack.
resources.Translated: 将魔复活加入循环，目标改为你的复活层数。

resources.Original: Adds Fated Brand into the AoE rotation when available.
resources.Translated: 当可用时，将命运之印加入AoE循环。

resources.Original: Replace Prominence with its combo chain.
resources.Translated: 将日珥斩替换为其连击链。

resources.Original:
Casts Searing Light only during Demi phases.
Spellspeed builds would turn this off.
resources.Translated:
仅在亚灵神阶段施放灼热之光。
咏速配装建议关闭此项。

resources.Original: Change Standard Step into each dance step, while dancing.
resources.Translated: 跳舞期间将标准舞步替换为各个舞步。

resources.Original: Adds Bloodbath and Second Wind to the combo, using them when below the HP Percentage threshold.
resources.Translated: 将浴血和内丹加入连击，在生命值百分比低于阈值时使用。

resources.Original: Retains 1 Lightspeed charge for manual use
resources.Translated: 保留1层光速充能供手动使用
在冷却就绪时加入已装备的蛮神技能。

resources.Original: Adds Rampart to the one-button mitigation.
Retargets Shirk to the other tank if there is one.
resources.Translated: 如果有另一个坦克，将退避的目标改为该坦克。

resources.Original: Adds Quietus to the rotation when under Delirium, or just after Burst.
resources.Translated: 在错乱剑状态下或爆发后立即将寂灭加入循环。

resources.Original:
Uses Zantetsuken when available.
- Will not use if target is invulnerable.
- Requires target to have player's Kuzushi.
resources.Translated:
可用时使用斩铁剑。
- 目标无敌时不使用。
- 需要目标带有自己的崩破。

resources.Original:
Replaces Doomspike with a full one-button AoE rotation.
These features are ideal if you want to customize the rotation.
resources.Translated:
将死之突进替换为完整的一键AoE循环。
如果你想自定义循环，这些功能非常理想。

resources.Original: Adds Bloodbath and Second Wind to the combo, using them when below the HP Percentage threshold.
resources.Translated: 将浴血和内丹加入连击，在生命值百分比低于阈值时使用。

resources.Original: Replace Hissatsu: Kyuten with Zanshin when usable.
resources.Translated: 可用时将必杀：九天替换为残心。

resources.Original: Saves high-damaging actions until the target's HP falls below the threshold.
resources.Translated: 将高伤害技能保留至目标HP低于阈值时使用。
将即刻咏唱替换为复活。

resources.Original: Weaves Rhizomata when Addersgall gauge falls below the specified value.
resources.Translated: 当蛇胆汁量表低于指定值时插入根素。

resources.Original: Triggers Pepsis if a shield is present.
resources.Translated: 若存在护盾则触发消化。

resources.Original:
Uses Forte when available.
- Will not use outside combat.
- Requires player's HP to be under:
resources.Translated:
可用时使用强音。
- 战斗外不使用。
- 需要自身HP低于：

resources.Original:
Replaces Heavy Swing with a full one-button single target rotation.
These features are ideal if you want to customize the rotation.
resources.Translated:
将重劈替换为完整的单键单体循环。
如果你想自定义循环，这些功能非常理想。

resources.Original: Adds Curing Waltz to the combo when available, and your HP is at or below the set percentage.
resources.Translated: 当技能可用且你的HP低于或等于设定百分比时，将治疗之华尔兹加入连击。

resources.Original: Retargets Kardia according to your Healing stack (even from the Soteria to Kardia Feature above)
resources.Translated: 根据你的治疗量层数重新指定心关目标（包括上方从拯救到心关的功能）

resources.Original:
Adds the Balance opener at level 70/80/90/100.
Prepull:
- Meikyo at -13
- True North at -5 (skipped if target has no positionals)
- Gekko on pull
Without a countdown, prepull steps have no delay.
(During a countdown only: blocks action until each prepull timing)
resources.Translated:
在70/80/90/100级时加入太阳神之衡起手。
预拉：
- 明镜止水于-13
- 真北于-5（若目标无身位则跳过）
- 拉怪时使用月光
无倒计时时，预拉步骤无延迟。
（仅在倒计时期间：阻止动作直到每个预拉时机）

resources.Original: Adds Holy Spellblade into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将魔法剑·神圣加入循环。

resources.Original: Adds the Balance opener from level 92 onwards.
resources.Translated: 从92级起加入太阳神之衡起手。

resources.Original: Retargets Earthly Star to the the ground Under yourself.
resources.Translated: 将地星重新指定到你脚下的地面。

resources.Original: Includes Flourish in the AoE rotation.
resources.Translated: 在群体循环中加入百花争艳。
简单治疗模式 - 单体

resources.Original:
Replaces Diagnosis with a full one-button single target healing utility.
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job. Particularly with autorotation.
resources.Translated:
将诊断替换为完整的一键单体治疗工具。
这是该职业新手的理想选择，尤其是配合自动循环时。

resources.Original: Enables the use of dot sub options below
resources.Translated: 启用下方的持续伤害子选项
吟游诗人持续伤害选项

resources.Original: Adds The Blackest Night when an incoming tankbuster is detected.
resources.Translated: 检测到即将到来的坦克杀手时添加至黑之夜。
至黑之夜坦克杀手选项

resources.Original: Retargets Lustrate according to your Healing stack.
resources.Translated: 根据你的治疗量堆叠重新指定生命活性法的目标。

resources.Original: Adds Dragonfire Dive to the rotation.
Adds Interject to the rotation when your target's cast is interruptible.
resources.Translated: 当目标咏唱可打断时，将插言加入循环。

resources.Original: Replace Hissatsu: Shinten with Senei when off cooldown.
resources.Translated: 冷却结束时将必杀剑：震天替换为闪影。

resources.Original: Adds Berserk / Inner Release into the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将狂暴 / 原初的解放加入循环。

resources.Original:
Options for Advanced Combos' In-Combo Mitigation.
Enable Mitigation in each Advanced Combo to use these options.
(Simple Mode does not use these Options, instead Recommended Values in place of them)
resources.Translated:
高级连击的连击中减伤选项。
在每个高级连击中启用减伤以使用这些选项。
（简单模式不使用这些选项，而是使用推荐值代替）
疾风/毒菌持续时间选项

resources.Original: Adds Aero/Dia to the single target combo if the debuff is not present on current target, or is about to expire.
resources.Translated: 如果当前目标没有该减益效果，或即将消失，则将疾风/毒菌加入单体连击。

resources.Original: Uses Rattling Coil when any condition is met.
resources.Translated: 满足任意条件时使用飞蛇之魂。

resources.Original: Turns Heavy Swing into an all-in-one damage button.
resources.Translated: 将重劈变为一键式综合输出按钮。

resources.Original: Add openers into the rotation based on Skill Speed and current Level, starting at Lv90.
resources.Translated: 根据技能速度和当前等级将起手式加入循环，从90级开始。

resources.Original: Changes Deep Clean to Peat Pelt if current target is not inflicted with Begrimed.
resources.Translated: 若当前目标未陷入泥污状态，则将大扫除变为玩泥球。

resources.Original:
Replaces Sonic Boom with a full one-button single target rotation.
Also used with Healer Mimicry when the party does not need healing.
resources.Translated:
将音爆替换为完整的一键式单体循环。
当队伍无需治疗时也用于治疗者模仿。

resources.Original: Adds Stellar Detonation when under the effect of Giant Dominance.
resources.Translated: 在巨星主宰效果下加入星体爆轰。

resources.Original:
Collection of cheeky or encounter-specific extra options only available to those in the know.
Do not expect these options to be maintained, or even kept, after they are no longer Current.
resources.Translated:
仅供内行人士使用的趣味或特定副本额外选项合集。
不要期望这些选项在不再流行后仍会维护，甚至保留。

resources.Original:
Replaces True Thrust with a full one-button single target rotation.
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job.
resources.Translated:
将精准刺替换为完整的一键式单体循环。
这是新手入门的理想选项。

resources.Original: Changes Holos into Eukrasion Prognosis to apply shields.
resources.Translated: 将坚壁之策变为预后以施加护盾。

resources.Original: Adds Paradox as a filler at max level to the rotation.
resources.Translated: 满级时在循环中加入悖论作为填充技能。

resources.Original: Will reapply DoT early to all enemies within range while moving.
resources.Translated: 移动时提前对范围内所有敌人重新施加持续伤害。

resources.Original: Adds Bloodfest into the AoE rotation when appropriate.
resources.Translated: 在合适时机将血壤加入群体循环。

resources.Original:
Replaces Bootshine with a full one-button single target rotation.
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job.
resources.Translated:
将连击替换为完整的单键单体循环。
这是新手入门的理想选项。

resources.Original: Retains 1 Lightspeed charge for manual use
resources.Translated: 保留1层光速充能供手动使用

resources.Original: Adds Flame Scroll into the rotation when the target has Fire Weakness.
resources.Translated: 当目标带有看穿弱点：火时，将火遁之术加入循环。

resources.Original: Adds Tenri Jindo to Advanced Mode.
resources.Translated: 将天理人道加入高级模式。

resources.Original:
Replaces Holy with a full one-button AoE rotation. 
This is the ideal option for newcomers to the job.
resources.Translated:
将神圣替换为完整的单键群体循环。
这是新手入门的理想选项。
简易输出模式 - 群体

resources.Original: Adds Shade Shift to Advanced Mode.

If your target's target is not you, will Retarget Nascent Flash onto them.
(if you're not top aggro, and not mousing over or hard targeting an ally)
resources.Translated:
如果你的目标的当前目标不是你，会将原初的勇猛重新选定目标到其身上。
（如果你不是最高仇恨，且没有鼠标悬停或硬选定一名队友）

resources.Original: Use Energy Drain to consume remaining Aetherflow stacks when Aetherflow is about to come off cooldown.
resources.Translated: 当以太超流即将冷却完毕时，使用能量吸收消耗剩余的以太超流层数。

resources.Original: Adds Superbolide when 5 or more targets as part of the mitigation rotation. (Recommended)
resources.Translated: 当目标数量达到5个或以上时，作为减伤循环的一部分加入超火流星。（推荐）
对多个目标维持持续伤害。

resources.Original: Includes Closed Position when out of combat and no dance partner is found.
resources.Translated: 在脱战且未找到舞伴时加入闭式舞姿。

resources.Original: Adds selected oGCD abilities to Carve And Spit and Abyssal Drain.
resources.Translated: 将选定的能力技加入精雕怒斩和吸血深渊。

resources.Original:
Gauss Round / Ricochet 
Double Check / Checkmate option
resources.Translated:
虹吸弹 / 弹射
双将 / 将死 选项

resources.Original: Adds Gauss Round and Ricochet or Double Check and Checkmate to the rotation. Will prevent overcapping.
resources.Translated: 将虹吸弹和弹射或双将和将死加入循环。可防止溢出。

resources.Original: Adds Role Action Diabrosis to Burst Mode below selected health
resources.Translated: 在低于选定生命值时将职能技能溃破加入爆发模式

resources.Original:
Adds Shield Bash to the rotation when your target is casting.
Not advised outside of overworld content, as it can waste a lot of GCDs on un-stun-able enemies, etc. Will try to not use it in boss fights.
resources.Translated:
当目标正在咏唱时将盾牌猛击加入循环。
不建议在野外内容之外使用，因为它可能会在无法眩晕的敌人等身上浪费大量GCD。会尽量避免在Boss战中使用。
使用盾牌猛击打断选项

resources.Original:
Adds Bulwark to the one-button mitigation.
NOTE: even if disabled, will still try to use Bulwark as the lowest priority.
resources.Translated:
将壁垒加入一键减伤。
注意：即使禁用，仍会尝试将壁垒作为最低优先级使用。

resources.Original:
Add Corps-a-corps when available for DPS. 
Will retain a charge for gap-closing.
resources.Translated:
在可用时加入短兵相接以提升输出。
会保留一层充能用于突进。

resources.Original: Replace Reaving Fangs with its combo chain.
resources.Translated: 将穿裂尖齿替换为其连击链。

resources.Original: Adds Cure 2/3 and Aquaveil to Burst combo below all damage options.
resources.Translated: 在所有伤害选项下方，将治疗2/3和水流幕加入爆发连招。

resources.Original:
Adds Grim Reaping to the rotation.
(Disabling this may stop the one-button combo working during enshroud)
resources.Translated:
将阴冷收割加入循环。
（禁用此项可能导致一键连招在夜游魂衣期间失效）

resources.Original: Replaces basic combo with Death Rattle or Last Lash when applicable.
resources.Translated: 在适用时用蛇尾击或蛇尾闪替换基础连招。

resources.Original:
Uses Corps-a-corps when available.
- Must remain within maximum range.
- Requires Enchanted Riposte to be available.
resources.Translated:
在可用时使用短兵相接。
- 必须保持在最大距离内。
- 需要魔回刺可用。

resources.Original: s, wait to Hypercharge until Tool cooldowns are at least this value
resources.Translated: 秒，等待超荷直到工具冷却至少达到此值

resources.Original: Replaces Scathe with Xenoglossy when available.
resources.Translated: 在可用时用异言替换灼烧。

resources.Original:
Replaces Demon Slice with a full one-button AoE rotation.

resources.Original:

将刃风替换为完整的一键单体循环。

将安魂祈祷替换为所有与安魂祈祷相关的技能。

resources.Translated: 在AoE循环中包含所有舞步、结束动作，以及可选的技巧舞步。

resources.Translated:
将毁坏IV加入AoE连击。
在迦楼罗阶段移动且无平衡时、在伊弗利特阶段移动时，或没有活跃的蛮神或半神召唤物时使用。
毁坏 IV 连击选项

resources.Original: Prevents overcap but pools at least one charge for burst window.
resources.Translated: 防止溢出，但至少保留一层充能用于爆发窗口。
使用短兵相接接近目标选项

resources.Original: Use Corp-a-corps when out of melee range and you have enough mana or Magicked Swordplay to start the melee combo
resources.Translated: 当不在近战范围内且拥有足够魔力或魔法剑术时使用短兵相接以开始近战连击

resources.Original:
Adds Circle of Scorn to Advanced Mode.

- Prefers to use during Fight or Flight.
resources.Translated:
将厄运流转加入高级模式。

- 优先在战逃反应期间使用。

resources.Original: Replaces Dissipation with Aetherflow when Aetherflow is available.
resources.Translated: 当以太超流可用时，用其替换转化。

resources.Original:

resources.Translated:
将雪仇剑加入一键减伤。

resources.Original: Adds Lucid Dreaming when MP drops below slider value.
resources.Translated: 当 MP 低于滑块数值时使用醒梦。

resources.Original: Use Banner of Noble Ends when available.
resources.Translated: 当背水境地可用时使用。

resources.Original:
Will try to cast Kerachole when a raidwide casting is detected. 
Will be used in all 4 main combos.
resources.Translated:
检测到全屏AOE读条时，将尝试施放坚角清汁。
将在全部4个主要连击中使用。

resources.Original: Adds selected features to the combo while moving.
resources.Translated: 移动时将所选功能加入连击。

resources.Original:
Adds Rose of Destruction, Feather Rain, Glass Dance, and J Kick to the combo.
Feather Rain is Retargeted to your target, so you don't have to place it.
resources.Translated:
将斗灵弹、飞翎雨、冰雪乱舞和J踢击加入连击。
飞翎雨会重新定位到你的目标，因此无需手动放置。

resources.Original: Adds Arm's Length to the one-button mitigation.
resources.Translated: 将亲疏自行加入一键减伤。
治疗职业：营救重新定位

resources.Original: Retargets Rescue (outside of combo usage) to UI Mouseover and additional options.
resources.Translated: 将营救（连击外使用）重新定位到UI鼠标悬停及其他选项。

resources.Original: Adds Phantom Kick into the rotation.
Adds Dark Missionary to the one-button mitigation.
resources.Translated: 将暗黑布道加入一键减伤。

resources.Original: Adds Full Metal Field to Burst Mode.
resources.Translated: 将全金属爆发加入爆发模式。

resources.Original: Adds UI mouseover to the priority, above Low HP option in priority.
resources.Translated: 将UI鼠标悬停加入优先级，位于低HP选项之上。

resources.Original:
Adds the Balance opener at level 90/100.
Standard opener prepull:
- Harpe at -1 (skipped in melee)

(During a countdown only: blocks action until each prepull timing)
resources.Translated:
在90/100级添加太阳神之衡起手。
标准起手预拉：
- 在-1秒时使用哈耳庇厄（近战跳过）
没有倒计时的情况下，预拉步骤没有延迟。
（仅在倒计时期间：阻止操作直到每个预拉时机）

resources.Original: Adds Bloodbath and Second Wind to the rotation.
resources.Translated: 将浴血和内丹加入循环。

resources.Original: Adds Tenri Jindo to Advanced Mode.
resources.Translated: 将天理人道加入高级模式。

resources.Original: Adds Rampart when 3 or more targets

resources.Translated: 当生命百分比达到阈值时，给予神圣领域最高优先级。

resources.Original:
Adds Mitigation to the combos when not in a boss encounter. Will not overlap separate options unless stated.
Will not use mitigation in the first 15 seconds of a pull unless you are not moving.
resources.Translated:
非首领战时将减伤加入连击。除非另有说明，否则不会与其他选项重叠。
开怪前15秒内不会使用减伤，除非你处于静止状态。

resources.Original: Use Banner of Honed Acuity when available.

resources.Translated: 将凤凰舞添加到爆发模式。

resources.Translated: 将天地人（冷却技能）加入高级模式。

resources.Translated: 在适当时将倍攻添加到命运之环。

resources.Original:
Replaces Low Blow (Stun) with Interject (Interrupt) when the target can be interrupted.

resources.Translated:
当目标可被打断时，将下踢（眩晕）替换为插言（打断）。
对于骑士，当插言和下踢都在冷却时，此功能将添加盾牌猛击。

resources.Original:
Will use intervention on your Hard Target if target is a friendly party member, if not then Sheltron.

resources.Translated:
如果目标是友方队员，将对你的硬目标使用干预，否则使用盾阵。
- UI鼠标悬停 > 硬目标 > 目标的目标 > 自身盾阵

resources.Original:
Replaces Fire in Red II with a full one-button AoE rotation.
These features are ideal if you want to customize the rotation.
resources.Translated:
将火炎之红II替换为完整的一键AoE循环。
如果你想自定义循环，这些功能非常理想。
将灵能添加到爆发模式。

resources.Original: Adds Role Action Diabrosis to Burst Mode below selected health
resources.Translated: 在低于选定生命值时将职能技能溃破加入爆发模式

resources.Original: Adds Vercure on self when solo or in a party with no healers.
resources.Translated: 在单人时或队伍中没有治疗师时，对自己使用赤治疗。

resources.Original: Adds Barrel Stabilizer to the rotation.
Uses Edge of Darkness in burst windows.
resources.Translated: 在爆发窗口内使用暗黑锋。

resources.Original: Adds Intervene to Burst Mode when in melee range.
resources.Translated: 在近战范围内将调停加入爆发模式。

resources.Translated: 将错乱剑（或嗜血）加入功能。

启用此项以在多变地下牢狱中添加多变技能。

当有全屏攻击读条时尝试插入礼仪之铃。

resources.Translated: 启用后将吟游诗人专属技能加入循环。

将战逃反应加入高级模式。

resources.Translated: 将夜游魂切割加入循环。

resources.Translated: 将先天禀赋重新指定到治疗量堆叠目标。

resources.Translated: 将猛者强击和战斗之声加入纷乱箭。

resources.Translated: 跳舞时将技巧舞步变为各个舞步。

resources.Translated: 将画素和灵感合并为一个按钮。

resources.Translated: 在低于选定生命值时将职能技能溃破加入爆发模式

resources.Translated: 使用时将狂暴 / 原初的解放转为蛮荒连击（蛮荒崩裂 -> 尽毁）。

resources.Original: Adds Bloodfest to Fated Circle when appropriate.
resources.Translated: 在适当时机将血壤加入命运之环。

resources.Original: Adds Disesteem to the rotation when available.
resources.Translated: 在可用时将掠影的蔑视加入循环。

在可用时使用失传即死。

resources.Translated:
用其连击链替换满月。
启用樱花连击选项后，此功能将变为一键基础连击。

resources.Original: Will Retarget the Raise affected here to your Heal Stack.
resources.Translated: 将此处受影响的复活重新指定给你的治疗小队。

resources.Translated: 在可用时将火炎 I 替换为火炎 IV。

resources.Translated: 保留暗影使者以在偶数分钟爆发窗口使用（掠影的蔑视之后）。

resources.Translated: 在高级 AoE 中插入歌曲。

resources.Translated: 启用后将炮击手专属技能加入循环。

resources.Translated: 将夜游魂钐割加入循环。

resources.Original:
Adds a Swiftcast->Holy at the beginning of your AoE rotation.

resources.Translated:
在群体循环开始时加入即刻咏唱→神圣。
需要你已进入战斗、停止移动，且尚未使用过法令。
即刻神圣开怪“起手”选项

resources.Translated: 在你未移动时加入纷乱雪月花和彼岸花。

resources.Original: Adds Double Gravity Cast to Burst Mode.
resources.Translated: 将双重重力施放加入爆发模式。

resources.Translated: 将迦楼罗加入单体循环

resources.Translated: 仅当无情处于激活状态时，将倍攻加入命运之环。

快速指定伤害卡牌目标

resources.Translated: 将苏生之炎重新指定给需要它的坦克，其次是需要治疗的队员，最后才是自己。

resources.Original:

It will look at DPS that suit the card first, following The Balance's priorities; if none found or they have buffs already, will look at the other DPS instead.
Will try to skip party members that have damage downs or rez sickness.
Will default to you if no suitable party members were found.
resources.Translated:
当你在连击中使用太阳神之衡或战争神之枪时，会自动将增益施加给队员。
它会优先查看适合该卡牌的DPS，遵循太阳神之衡的优先级；如果没有找到或他们已有增益，则会查看其他DPS。
会尝试跳过带有伤害降低或复活虚弱的队员。
如果没有找到合适的队员，则默认施放给自己。

resources.Original:
Will Retarget Shirk to healers, instead of the other tank.
Only recommended during some specific enrages.
resources.Translated:
将退避重新指定给治疗，而不是另一名坦克。
仅建议在某些特定的狂暴阶段使用。

resources.Translated: 当你超出范围时，将飞斧加入循环。

将旋转钐割替换为完整的一键AoE循环。

Adds mitigations into the rotations automatically when not in a boss encounter.

当不在首领战斗中时，自动将减伤加入循环。

resources.Translated: 根据你的治疗量（甚至来自上方的均衡功能）重新指定均衡诊断的目标

resources.Original:
Replaces Fire in Red with a full one-button single target rotation.

将火炎之红替换为完整的单键单体循环。

70级以下时冷却好了就用。

resources.Translated: 将断绝和梦幻三段添加到高级模式。
断绝 / 梦幻三段选项

resources.Original: Will Retarget the Raise affected here to your Raise Stack.
resources.Translated: 将此处受复活影响的目标重新指向你的复活队列。
将发炎添加到爆发模式。

resources.Original: Adds Occult Missile into the rotation.
Adds Lightning Scroll into the rotation when the target has Lightning Weakness.
resources.Translated: 当目标具有看穿弱点：雷时，将雷遁之术加入循环。

resources.Original: Retargets Taurochole according to your Healing stack (even from the Taurochole to Druochole Feature above)
resources.Translated: 根据你的治疗队列重新指向白牛清汁（包括上方白牛清汁转灵橡清汁功能）

resources.Original: Adds Rekindle to the AoE combo.
resources.Translated: 将苏生之炎添加到群体连击。

resources.Original: Includes Fan Dance 4 when under Fourfold Fan Dance.
resources.Translated: 在扇舞·终状态下包含扇舞·序4。

resources.Original: Turns Sonic Boom into Sharpened Knife when in melee range.
resources.Translated: 在近战范围内将音爆变为锋利菜刀。

resources.Original: Single Target HP% Threshold (target has Regen/Aspected Benefic)
resources.Translated: 单体目标HP%阈值（目标具有再生/吉星相位）

resources.Original: Disabling this will turn off AoE DPS features. Otherwise will require the amount of targets required to be in range of an AoE feature's attack to use. This applies to all 3 roles, and for any features that deal AoE damage.
resources.Translated: 禁用后将关闭所有 AoE DPS 功能。否则需要范围内有足够数量的目标才会使用 AoE 技能。此设置适用于全部 3 种职能，以及所有造成 AoE 伤害的功能。

resources.Original: Requires {0} or {1}'s {2} to be available to resurrect a party member, to avoid hard-casting.
resources.Translated: 需要 {0} 或 {1} 的 {2} 可用时才会复活队友，以避免硬读条。
处理检测到的坦克杀手

resources.Original: Don't set this too high! 1-2 seconds is normally comfy enough to be considered a natural reaction.
resources.Translated: 不要设置得太高！1-2 秒通常就足够舒适，可视为自然反应。

resources.Original:
These NPCs will be ignored by Auto-Rotation.
Every instance of this NPC will be excluded from automatic targeting (Manual will still work).
To remove an NPC from this list, select it and press the Delete button below.
To add an NPC to this list, target the NPC and use the command: /wrath ignore
resources.Translated:
这些 NPC 将被自动循环忽略。
该 NPC 的每个实例都会被排除在自动选定目标之外（手动仍可使用）。
要将某个 NPC 从此列表中移除，请选中它并按下方的删除按钮。
要将某个 NPC 添加到此列表，请选定该 NPC 并使用命令：/wrath ignore
优先选定非战斗中的目标

resources.Original: Will try to use actions before detected tankbusters to mitigate damage on targeted member. Max 1 action (excluding {0} for setup)
resources.Translated: 会在检测到坦克杀手前尝试使用技能，以减轻被选定目标的伤害。最多 1 个技能（不包括用于设置的 {0}）

resources.Original: Pauses all actions that would come from combos if there is no target selected with the selected targeting mode. Ideal for blocking self-use actions if no target is available.
resources.Translated: 如果使用所选选定目标模式没有选中目标，则暂停所有来自连击的技能。适合在没有可用目标时阻止自身使用的技能。

resources.Original: Single Target HP% Threshold (target has Excogitation)
resources.Translated: 单体 HP% 阈值（目标拥有深谋远虑之策）

resources.Original: Disabling this will turn off AoE Healing features. Otherwise will require the amount of targets required to be in range of an AoE feature's heal to use.
resources.Translated: 禁用后将关闭所有 AoE 治疗功能。否则需要范围内有足够数量的目标才会使用 AoE 治疗技能。

resources.Original: Disables Auto-Mode outside of combat unless you're synced to a FATE.
resources.Translated: 在战斗外禁用自动模式，除非你同步到 FATE。
单体目标 HP% 阈值

resources.Original: For all other targeting modes, AoE will target based on highest number of targets hit. In manual mode, it will only do this if you tick this box.
resources.Translated: 对于所有其他选定目标模式，AoE 将根据命中目标数量最多的位置选定目标。在手动模式下，只有勾选此框才会如此。

resources.Original: You typically want to set this lower than the above setting.
resources.Translated: 通常建议将此设置得比上面的设置更低。

resources.Original: Switches {0} to party members currently being targeted by enemies, prioritising tanks if multiple people are being targeted.
resources.Translated: 将 {0} 切换至当前被敌人选为目标的小队成员，若有多人被选为目标则优先坦克。

resources.Original: When in boss fights only, any target regardless of distance can be eligible to be attacked.
resources.Translated: 仅在 Boss 战中，任何目标无论距离均可被攻击。

resources.Original:
Manual - Will only heal a target if you select them manually. If the target does not meet the healing threshold settings criteria below it will skip healing in favour of DPSing (if also enabled).
Highest Current - Prioritises the party member with the highest current HP%.
Lowest Current - Prioritises the party member with the lowest current HP%.
resources.Translated:
手动 - 仅当你手动选择目标时才会治疗该目标。若目标不满足下方的治疗阈值设置条件，将跳过治疗转而输出（若也已启用）。
当前最高 - 优先选择当前 HP% 最高的小队成员。
当前最低 - 优先选择当前 HP% 最低的小队成员。

resources.Original: Max distance all targeting modes (except Manual) will look for a target. Values from 1 to 30 only.
resources.Translated: 所有选定目标模式（手动除外）寻找目标的最大距离。仅限 1 到 30 的数值。

resources.Original: Will {0} any cleansable debuffs (Healing takes priority).
resources.Translated: 将{0}任何可净化的减益（治疗优先）。

resources.Original: Targets Required for AoE Damage Features
resources.Translated: AoE 伤害功能所需目标数
处理检测到的全屏攻击
强制最佳 AoE 目标选择

resources.Original: Targets Required for AoE Healing Features
resources.Translated: AoE 治疗功能所需目标数

resources.Original: Applies {0}/{1}/{2}/{3} to your focus target when out of combat and they are 30y or less away from an enemy. (Bypasses "Restrict to Combat Only" setting)
resources.Translated: 当脱离战斗且焦点目标距离敌人 30 米或以内时，对其施加 {0}/{1}/{2}/{3}。（绕过“仅限战斗”设置）

resources.Original: You typically want to set this lower than the above setting.
resources.Translated: 通常建议将此设置得比上面的设置更低。

resources.Original: Bypass When Combo Suggests Self-Use Action
resources.Translated: 连击建议自身使用技能时绕过
进入副本内容时自动启用

resources.Original:
Will attempt to resurrect dead party members.
Applies to {0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4}, and {5} ({6}/{7})

This is where you can configure the parameters in which Auto-Rotation will operate.
Features marked with an 'Auto-Mode' checkbox are able to be used with Auto-Rotation.
resources.Translated:
在此可配置自动循环的运行参数。
带有“自动模式”复选框的功能可与自动循环一起使用。

resources.Original: This will make Auto-Rotation use actions with cast times even whilst moving, as Orbwalker will lock movement during the cast. You may need to enable "Buffer Initial Cast" setting in Orbwalker if not already enabled. Requires an Orbwalker plugin to be installed and enabled.
resources.Translated: 这将使自动循环在移动时也能使用带咏唱时间的技能，因为 Orbwalker 会在咏唱期间锁定移动。如果尚未启用，你可能需要在 Orbwalker 中启用“缓冲初始咏唱”设置。需要安装并启用 Orbwalker 插件。

resources.Original: When playing as {0} or {1}, also attempt to raise a dead party member. {2} will only resurrect with {3} or {4} active.
resources.Translated: 以 {0} 或 {1} 游玩时，也会尝试复活死亡的队员。{2} 仅在 {3} 或 {4} 激活时才会复活。

resources.Original: This will un-set any current target and disable Auto-Rotation actions if there is a current detected action penalty, such as Pyretics (or similar, like Acceleration Bomb) affecting the player, that would harm them if they took any action.
resources.Translated: 如果检测到当前存在行动惩罚（例如 Pyretics 或类似效果，如加速度炸弹）影响玩家，且采取任何行动都会对其造成伤害，这将取消当前目标并禁用自动循环技能。

resources.Original: Will still AoE on the best target, but only after you've set a hard target first (this may be switched to the best target afterwards).
resources.Translated: 仍会对最佳目标进行 AoE，但仅在你先设定了硬目标之后（之后可能会切换到最佳目标）。

resources.Original: When enemies have numbered nameplate markers (1–5), Auto-Rotation will only attack the lowest remaining number until it dies. Used for treasure map vermin; also applies anywhere those markers appear.
resources.Translated: 当敌人带有编号名牌标记（1–5）时，自动循环只会攻击剩余编号最低的目标直到其死亡。用于藏宝图害虫；也适用于任何出现这些标记的地方。

resources.Original: Delay to activate Auto-Rotation once combat starts (seconds)
resources.Translated: 战斗开始后延迟启动自动循环（秒）

resources.Original: Pause Actions from Combos When No Target Selected
resources.Translated: 未选择目标时暂停连击技能

resources.Original: Auto-rotation does not need to target allies to work, however with this setting enabled it will always set your hard target when it executes a heal.
resources.Translated: 自动循环无需选定队友即可运作，但启用此设置后，执行治疗时会始终设置你的硬目标。

resources.Original: Only Attack Targets Already In Combat
resources.Translated: 仅攻击已进入战斗的目标

resources.Original: Includes shield% in all HP checks.
resources.Translated: 在所有血量检查中包含护盾百分比。

resources.Original: Apply to Out of Party Members

Manual - Leaves all targeting decisions to you.
Highest Max - Prioritises enemies with the highest max HP.
Lowest Max - Prioritises enemies with the lowest max HP.
Highest Current - Prioritises the enemy with the highest current HP.
Lowest Current - Prioritises the enemy with the lowest current HP.
Tank Target - Prioritises the same target as the first tank in your group.
Nearest - Prioritises the closest target to you.
Furthest - Prioritises the furthest target from you.
resources.Translated:
手动 - 所有选定目标决策交由你处理。
最高上限 - 优先选择最大血量最高的敌人。
最低上限 - 优先选择最大血量最低的敌人。
最高当前 - 优先选择当前血量最高的敌人。
最低当前 - 优先选择当前血量最低的敌人。
坦克目标 - 优先选择与你队伍中第一位坦克相同的目标。
最近 - 优先选择离你最近的目标。
最远 - 优先选择离你最远的目标。

resources.Original: Delay to start healing once above conditions are met (seconds)
resources.Translated: 满足上述条件后延迟开始治疗（秒）

resources.Original: Auto-Rotation has a built in throttler to only run every so many milliseconds for performance reasons. If you experience issues with frame rate, try increasing this value. Do note this may have a side-effect of introducing clipping if set too high, so experiment with the value.
resources.Translated: 出于性能考虑，自动循环内置了节流器，仅每隔若干毫秒运行一次。如果你遇到帧率问题，请尝试增大此值。请注意，若设置过高，可能会产生技能卡顿的副作用，因此请自行试验该值。

resources.Original: Useful for healer quests where NPCs are expected to be healed but aren't added directly to your party.
resources.Translated: 适用于治疗任务中需要治疗但未直接加入你队伍的 NPC。

resources.Original: Disables Auto-Mode outside of combat unless you're within range of a quest target.
resources.Translated: 在战斗外禁用自动模式，除非你处于任务目标范围内。

resources.Original: Ignore Max Target Distance In Boss Fights
resources.Translated: Boss 战中忽略最大目标距离

resources.Original: Many jobs have an out of combat action that can be used, for example, {0} or {1}. This will allow these to be used without being in combat.
resources.Translated: 许多职业都有可在战斗外使用的技能，例如 {0} 或 {1}。这将允许它们在未进入战斗时使用。

resources.Original: Auto-rotation does not need to target enemies to work, however with this setting enabled it will always set your hard target when it executes an attack.
resources.Translated: 自动循环无需选定敌人即可运作，但启用此设置后，执行攻击时会始终设置你的硬目标。

resources.Original: When playing as {0} or {1}, Will only attempt to res Healers and Raisers
resources.Translated: 以 {0} 或 {1} 游玩时，仅会尝试复活治疗职业和复活职业

resources.Original: Will try to use actions before detected raidwides or group damage to either mitigate or top-off party members. Max 3 actions (excluding {0} for setup)
resources.Translated: 会在检测到全屏攻击或群体伤害前尝试使用技能，以减伤或补满队员血量。最多 3 个技能（不含用于设置的 {0}）

resources.Original: This will determine how soon before the GCD is finished to queue up the next weaponskill or spell. Your latency may have an effect on what actions are performed so please adjust this if you're noticing improper action use, i.e double Blizzard IV casts due to MP not updating in time.
resources.Translated: 决定在 GCD 结束前多久开始排队下一个武器技能或魔法。你的延迟可能会影响执行的技能，因此如果发现技能使用异常，请调整此项，例如因 MP 未及时更新而重复施放冰结 IV。

resources.Original: Only AoE When Manual Target is Set
resources.Translated: 仅在手动设置目标时使用 AoE

resources.Original: This option is currently included in the burst toggle.
resources.Translated: 此选项当前已包含在爆发开关中。

resources.Original: These are PvP features. They will only work in PvP-enabled zones.
resources.Translated: 这些是 PvP 功能。它们仅在启用 PvP 的区域中生效。

resources.Original: Equip your job stone to re-unlock features.
resources.Translated: 装备你的职业水晶以重新解锁功能。

resources.Original: Action Replacing is Disabled in Settings! PvP Combos will not work!
resources.Translated: 设置中已禁用技能替换！PvP 连招将无法工作！

resources.Original: The setting that controls if this action is retargeted is:
resources.Translated: 控制此技能是否重新选择目标的设置为：

resources.Original: This Feature's actions may be retargeted.
resources.Translated: 此功能的技能可能会重新选择目标。
PvP 无法使用自动循环。
此功能的技能会重新选择目标
所有必需魔法均已激活！

resources.Original: Select a job from below to enable and configure features for it.
resources.Translated: 从下方选择一个职业以启用并配置其功能。

resources.Original: This option is currently *not* included in the burst toggle.
resources.Translated: 此选项当前*未*包含在爆发开关中。

resources.Original: Adds or removes this option from the list of options that will be toggled using `/wrath burst custom`
resources.Translated: 将此项添加或移出可通过 `/wrath burst custom` 切换的选项列表

resources.Original:
Using plugins like Redirect or Reaction with configurations
affecting this action will Conflict and may cause issues.
resources.Translated:
使用 Redirect 或 Reaction 等插件，且其配置
会影响此技能时，将产生冲突并可能导致问题。

resources.Original:
The actions from this Feature will automatically be
targeted onto what the developers feel is the best target
(following The Balance where applicable).
resources.Translated:
此功能中的技能将自动
以开发者认为的最佳目标为目标
（在适用时遵循太阳神之衡）。

resources.Original:
Add this feature to Auto-Rotation.
Auto-Rotation will automatically use the actions selected within the feature, allowing you to focus on movement. Configure the settings in the 'Auto-Rotation' section.
resources.Translated:
将此功能添加到自动循环。
自动循环将自动使用该功能中选定的技能，让你专注于走位。在“自动循环”部分配置设置。

resources.Original: Option name, ID, Internal Name, Description, etc
resources.Translated: 选项名称、ID、内部名称、描述等

resources.Original:

{0}'s Settings, which you have enabled:
{1}

It is recommended you disable these plugins, or
remove the conflicting setting in the plugins
to prevent unexpected behavior and bugs.
resources.Translated:
以下插件已知会与你已启用的
{0} 设置冲突：
{1}

建议你禁用这些插件，或
移除插件中冲突的设置，
以避免异常行为和错误。

resources.Original:
The following plugins are known to conflict with {0}:

{1}

It is recommended you disable these plugins, or their rotation
components, to prevent unexpected behavior and bugs.
resources.Translated:
以下插件已知会与 {0} 冲突：

{1}

建议你禁用这些插件或其循环
组件，以避免异常行为和错误。

resources.Original: You have conflict(s) in your Dalamud config:
resources.Translated: 你的 Dalamud 配置中存在冲突：

resources.Original:
Your configuration in the following plugins will conflict
with {0}'s enabled Action Retargeting:
{1}

It is recommended you disable these plugins, or
remove the conflicting actions from their settings, or
disable Retargeting for the action in {0},
to prevent unexpected behavior and bugs.
resources.Translated:
你在以下插件中的配置将与
{0} 已启用的技能重新指定目标冲突：
{1}

建议你禁用这些插件，或
从它们的设置中移除冲突的技能，或
在 {0} 中禁用该技能的重新指定目标，
以避免异常行为和错误。

resources.Original:
Will print the status of your Job's Opener to chat.
e.g. When it is Ready, Fails, or Finishes.
resources.Translated:
将你的职业起手状态输出到聊天栏。
例如：就绪、失败或完成时。
焦点目标 > 硬目标 > 自身
重新选定目标（单体）治疗技能

resources.Original: Show a message on-screen whenever a tankbuster is detected, including who it is targeting.
resources.Translated: 检测到坦克杀手时在屏幕上显示消息，包括其选定的目标。

resources.Original: Opener Status in Server Info Bar
resources.Translated: 服务器信息栏中的起手状态

resources.Original:
Will add any UI MouseOver targets to the top of the Default Heal Stack, overriding the rest of the stack if you are mousing over any party member UI.

It is recommended to enable this if you are a keyboard+mouse user and enable Retarget Healing Actions (or have UI MouseOver targets in your Redirect/Reaction configuration).
resources.Translated:
将任何 UI 鼠标悬停目标添加到默认治疗优先级顶部，当你鼠标悬停在任何队员 UI 上时覆盖其余优先级。

如果你是键鼠用户并启用了重新选定目标治疗技能（或在重定向/反应配置中有 UI 鼠标悬停目标），建议启用此项。

resources.Original: Open PvE Features Tab to Current Job on Switching Jobs
resources.Translated: 切换职业时打开当前职业的 PvE 功能标签页

resources.Original: 0.0-1.0 (Above that gets into the territory of breaking any Movement Options in your Job)
resources.Translated: 0.0-1.0（超过此范围会破坏你职业的任何移动选项）

resources.Original: Setting this too low or to zero will make it really hard to manually queue.
resources.Translated: 设置得太低或为零会导致手动排队非常困难。

resources.Original:
Will add any MouseOver targets to the top of the Default Heal Stack, overriding the rest of the stack if you are mousing over any party member UI.

It is recommended to enable this if you are a keyboard+mouse user and enable Retarget Healing Actions (or have UI MouseOver targets in your Redirect/Reaction configuration).
resources.Translated:
将任何鼠标悬停目标添加到默认治疗优先级顶部，当你鼠标悬停在任何队员 UI 上时覆盖其余优先级。

如果你是键鼠用户并启用了重新选定目标治疗技能（或在重定向/反应配置中有 UI 鼠标悬停目标），建议启用此项。

resources.Original: Draws a box around party members in the vanilla Party List, when targeted by certain Features.
resources.Translated: 当某些功能选定队员为目标时，在原版队员列表中为其绘制方框。

resources.Original:
Controls the percentage of a total cast time to wait before interrupting enemy casts.
Applies to all interrupts (including stuns used to interrupt) in every Job's Combos.
resources.Translated:
控制等待多少总咏唱时间百分比后再打断敌人咏唱。
适用于所有职业连招中的所有打断技能（包括用于打断的眩晕）。

resources.Original: On, cause it's that type of day y'know
resources.Translated: 开启，因为今天就是这种日子嘛

resources.Original: This will add your focus target under your hard and soft targets in the Default Heal Stack, overriding the rest of the stack if you have a living focus target.
resources.Translated: 这会将你的焦点目标添加到默认治疗优先级中，位于硬目标和软目标之下；若你有存活的焦点目标，则覆盖优先级中的其余部分。

resources.Original:
This controls how long of a delay is needed before Wrath recognizes you as moving.
This allows you to not have to worry about small movements affecting your rotation, primarily for casters.
resources.Translated:
控制 Wrath 判定你为移动状态所需的延迟时长。
这让你无需担心小幅移动影响循环，主要针对读条职业。

resources.Original: Will allow you to queue when the GCD is at this time or less.
resources.Translated: 当 GCD 剩余时间小于等于该值时允许排队。

resources.Original: Add UI MouseOver to the Default Healing Stack
resources.Translated: 将 UI 鼠标悬停目标加入默认治疗优先级

resources.Original: For when you can't get enough MNK in your plugin.
resources.Translated: 献给那些在插件里怎么也玩不够武僧的人。

resources.Original: On (If you customize the Heal Stack AT ALL)
resources.Translated: 开启（如果你对治疗优先级做了任何自定义）

resources.Original:
Wrath is largely designed with Action Replacing in mind.
Only Auto-Rotation will work if this is disabled.
Disabling it may also lead to unexpected behavior, such as regarding Retargeting.
resources.Translated:
Wrath 的设计主要基于技能替换。
若禁用此项，则只有自动循环可用。
禁用还可能导致意外行为，例如涉及重新选定目标时。

resources.Original: Open Wrath to the PvE Features Tab
resources.Translated: 打开 Wrath 时进入 PvE 功能标签页

resources.Original: Add Focus Target to the Default Healing Stack
resources.Translated: 将焦点目标加入默认治疗优先级

resources.Original: Controls the color of the box drawn around party members.
resources.Translated: 控制绘制在队员周围的方框颜色。

resources.Original: When the PvE Features tab is opened it will automatically open to your current Job.
resources.Translated: 打开 PvE 功能标签页时自动切换到当前职业。

resources.Original:
Controls how many oGCDs are allowed between GCDs.
The 'default' for the game is double weaving, but triple weaving is completely possible with low enough latency (of every kind);but if you struggle with latency of any sort then single weaving may even be a good answer to try for you.
Triple weaving is already done in a manner where we try to avoid clipping GCDs, and as such doesn't happen particularly often even if you have good latency, and is a valid thing to do, so it is a safe option if you want.
resources.Translated:
控制 GCD 之间允许插入的能力技数量。
游戏的“默认”是双插，但在延迟足够低（各种延迟）的情况下三插完全可行；不过如果你受任何延迟困扰，单插甚至可能是个值得尝试的好选择。
三插的实现方式已尽量避免卡 GCD，因此即便延迟良好也不会特别频繁，且是可行的做法，所以想用的话是个安全的选择。

resources.Original: Will play a text-to-speech sound clip whenever a stack/group damage cast is detected, including who it is targeting if applicable.
resources.Translated: 检测到群体伤害读条时播放语音播报，若适用还会包含目标对象。

resources.Original: Will play a text-to-speech sound clip whenever a tankbuster is detected, including who it is targeting.
resources.Translated: 检测到坦克死刑时播放语音播报，包含目标对象。
将起手状态输出到聊天

resources.Original: Will prevent the Message of the Day from being shown in your chat upon login.
resources.Translated: 将阻止登录时在聊天中显示每日消息。

resources.Original:
This will add any NPCs that are not in your party to the retargeting logic for healing actions.

Useful for healers who want to be able to target NPCs that are not in their party, such as quest NPCs.
These NPCs will not generally work with any role-based custom Heal Stack entries
(even if an NPC looks like a tank, they're not always classified as one)
resources.Translated:
这会将不在你队伍中的 NPC 加入治疗技能的重新选定目标逻辑。

对于希望选定不在队伍中的 NPC（如任务 NPC）的治疗职业很有用。
这些 NPC 通常不适用于任何基于职能的自定义治疗优先级条目
（即使某个 NPC 看起来像坦克，也不一定被归类为坦克）

resources.Original:
Will completely block actions while moving.
This would supersede combo-specific movement options, which many jobs have.
resources.Translated:
移动时将完全阻止技能。
这将覆盖许多职业拥有的连招专属移动选项。

resources.Original: Will draw a border around Combos and Features that have Features and Options of their own.
resources.Translated: 将为拥有自身功能与选项的连招和功能绘制边框。

resources.Original: Controls whether Search Bars should be shown in Settings, and PvE and PvP Jobs.
resources.Translated: 控制是否在设置以及 PvE 和 PvP 职业中显示搜索栏。

resources.Original: Off (Most Jobs will handle this better with their Features)
resources.Translated: 关闭（大多数职业用其功能处理会更好）
屏蔽自动循环命令反馈

resources.Original: On (IF trying to report an issue)
resources.Translated: 开启（如果要报告问题时）

resources.Original: This will add a nearby party member with the lowest HP% to bottom of the Default Heal Stack, overriding only yourself.
resources.Translated: 这会将附近生命值百分比最低的队伍成员添加到默认治疗优先级底部，仅覆盖你自己。

resources.Original: This will allow you to overwrite whatever is currently queued up with another action.
resources.Translated: 这将允许你用另一个技能覆盖当前已排队的技能。

resources.Original: below 40 (Above that and you start failing to interrupt many short casts)
resources.Translated: 低于 40（高于此值你将开始无法打断许多短读条）

resources.Original: On (If you use Retargeting at all)
resources.Translated: 开启（如果你使用重新选定目标）

resources.Original: Off, unless your name starts with Beep
resources.Translated: 关闭，除非你的名字以 Beep 开头

resources.Original: Show Preset IDs next to Combo Names
resources.Translated: 在连招名称旁显示预设 ID

resources.Original:
Displays the Preset ID number next to the name of each Combo and Feature.
These are the IDs used for commands like `/wrath toggle <ID>`.
Pre-7.3 the behavior was to show a number here, but it was much shorter, and did not work in commands.
resources.Translated:
在每个连招和功能的名称旁显示预设 ID 编号。
这些是用于诸如 ` /wrath toggle <ID>` 等命令的 ID。
7.3 之前的行为是在此处显示一个数字，但短得多，且无法用于命令。

resources.Original:
This is the order in which Wrath will try to select a target to Raise,
if Retargeting of any Raise Feature is enabled.

You can find Raise Features under PvE>General,
or under each caster that has a Raise.

If there are fewer than 5 items, and all return nothing when checked, will fall back to:
your Hard Target if they're dead, or <Any Dead Party Member>.

These targets will only be considered valid if they are friendly, dead, and within 30y.
resources.Translated:
这是 Wrath 尝试选择复活目标的顺序，
前提是任意复活功能的重新选定目标已启用。

你可以在 PvE>常规 下找到复活功能，
或在每个拥有复活技能的施法职业下找到。

如果项目少于 5 个，且检查时全部无返回，将回退到：
你的硬目标（若已死亡），或 <任意死亡队员>。

这些目标仅在友好、死亡且 30y 内时才会被视为有效。

resources.Original: Open Wrath to the PvP Features Tab in PvP areas
resources.Translated: 在 PvP 区域打开 Wrath 时切换到 PvP 功能标签页

resources.Original:
This is a new way of evaluating current HP values, using pre-emptively obtained values to update health values internally before it is reflected in-game properly.

As such, you may see things happen earlier than what may be expected, as values for damage and healing are generated much earlier than shown in game. For example, as soon as you hit the slidecast window the value of the spell is already known.

This is actually best recommended for healers using auto-rotation to mitigate the amount of double casted heals. For DPS, this will switch targets with auto-rotation the moment a killing blow goes out, rather than waiting until the target is officially recognized as dead.

Used currently when evaluating HP% checks in features and auto-rotation.
resources.Translated:
这是一种评估当前 HP 值的新方式，使用预先获取的值在游戏内正确反映之前于内部更新生命值。

因此，你可能会看到事情比预期更早发生，因为伤害和治疗值生成得比游戏内显示早得多。例如，一旦你进入滑步施法窗口，该法术的值就已经确定。

实际上，这最推荐给使用自动循环的治疗职业，以减少重复施放的治疗量。对于 DPS，这会在致命一击发出的瞬间就通过自动循环切换目标，而不是等到目标被正式判定为死亡。

目前用于在功能和自动循环中评估 HP% 检查。

resources.Original: Show a message on-screen whenever a stack/group damage cast is detected, including who it is targeting if applicable.
resources.Translated: 每当检测到分摊/群体伤害施法时在屏幕上显示消息，包括其选定目标（如适用）。

resources.Original: Add Field MouseOver to the Default Healing Stack
resources.Translated: 将场地鼠标悬停添加到默认治疗堆叠

resources.Original:
Will hide the number of active Auto-Mode Combos.
By default the Server Info Bar shows:
- Whether Auto-Rotation is on or off
- (if on) The number of active Auto-Mode Combos
- (if applicable) Whether another plugin is controlling the state of Auto-Rotation.
resources.Translated:
将隐藏激活的自动模式连击数量。
默认情况下，服务器信息栏显示：
- 自动循环是否开启
- （若开启）激活的自动模式连击数量
- （如适用）是否有其他插件控制自动循环的状态。

resources.Original: Show Borders around Combos and Features with Options
resources.Translated: 在带有选项的连击和功能周围显示边框

resources.Original: Open PvE Features Tab to Current Job on Opening
resources.Translated: 打开时将 PvE 功能标签页切换到当前职业

resources.Original: Shows the status of your current opener, if enabled and applicable.
resources.Translated: 显示你当前起手的状态（若已启用且适用）。

resources.Original: Will hide the Features and Options under disabled Combos.
resources.Translated: 将隐藏已禁用连击下的功能和选项。

resources.Original: Use a Custom Heal Stack Instead
resources.Translated: 使用自定义治疗优先级

resources.Original: Add Lowest HP% Ally to the Default Healing Stack
resources.Translated: 将最低血量队友加入默认治疗优先级

resources.Original:
Select this if you would rather make your own stack of target priorities for Heal Targets instead of using our default stack.

It is recommended to use this to align with your Redirect/Reaction configuration IF you're not using the Retarget Healing Actions option above; otherwise it is preference.
resources.Translated:
如果你希望为治疗目标自定义目标优先级，而不是使用我们的默认优先级，请选择此项。

如果你没有使用上方的重定向治疗技能选项，建议使用此项以与你的重定向/反应配置保持一致；否则仅为个人偏好。

resources.Original:
Controls what is considered to be in melee range.
Mainly for those who don't want to switch to ranged attacks if the boss walks slightly outside of range.
For example a value of -0.5 would make you have to be 0.5 yalms closer to the target,
or a value of 2 would allow you to be 2 yalms further away and still be considered in melee range
(melee actions wouldn't work, but it would give you some warning instead of just suddenly doing less optimal actions).
resources.Translated:
控制什么范围被视为近战范围。
主要适用于那些不想在Boss稍微走出范围时就切换到远程攻击的人。
例如，值为-0.5意味着你必须离目标近0.5米，
而值为2则允许你离目标远2米仍被视为在近战范围内
（近战技能不会生效，但会给你一些提示，而不是突然执行次优技能）。

resources.Original: Will hide Combos that conflict with Combos that you have enabled.
resources.Translated: 将隐藏与你已启用的连击冲突的连击。

resources.Original:
If there are fewer than 4 items, and all return nothing when checked, will fall back to Self.

These targets will only be considered valid if they are friendly and within 25y.

When applied to something like Esuna, these targets will be checked for having a Cleansable Debuff, etc.
So adding 'Any Cleansable Ally' or similar is not necessary.
resources.Translated:
如果少于4个条目，且所有条目检查后均无返回，则回退到自身。

这些目标只有在友好且距离25米以内时才被视为有效。

当应用于诸如康复之类的技能时，这些目标会被检查是否具有可净化的减益等。
因此无需添加“任意可净化队友”或类似选项。

resources.Original: Increase with higher latency to the server
resources.Translated: 服务器延迟越高，此值应越大
缩短服务器信息栏文本

resources.Original: Will hide chat feedback for /wrath auto commands
resources.Translated: 将隐藏 /wrath auto 命令的聊天反馈

resources.Original:
Same as above, when you open Wrath with `/wrath`, it will open to the PvP Features tab, instead of the last tab you were on, when in a PvP area.
Similar to using the `/wrath pvp` command to open Wrath.
resources.Translated:
同上，当你在PvP区域使用 `/wrath` 打开Wrath时，将打开PvP功能标签页，而不是你上次所在的标签页。
类似于使用 `/wrath pvp` 命令打开Wrath。

resources.Original:
Will hide chat feedback for /wrath set and /wrath unset commands.
(Will still show feedback if the command is being overriden by IPC, or fails)
resources.Translated:
将隐藏 /wrath set 和 /wrath unset 命令的聊天反馈。
（如果命令被IPC覆盖或失败，仍会显示反馈）

resources.Original: Any Healer > Any Tank > Any Raiser > Any Dead Party Member
resources.Translated: 任意治疗职业 > 任意坦克职业 > 任意复活职业 > 任意死亡队友

resources.Original:
Controls whether Actions on your Hotbar will be Replaced with combos from the plugin.
If disabled, your manual presses of abilities will no longer be affected by any Wrath settings.

Auto-Rotation will work regardless of the setting.
resources.Translated:
控制技能栏上的技能是否会被插件的连击替换。
如果禁用，你手动按下的技能将不再受任何Wrath设置影响。

自动循环不受此设置影响，仍会正常工作。
（所有目标都会检查是否可复活）

resources.Original:
Controls how long of a gap with no action is allowed in an Opener, before it is considered failed and normal rotation is resumed.
Can be necessary for some casters to increase, particularly when the first action of an Opener is a hard-cast.
resources.Translated:
控制起手式中允许无操作间隔的时长，超过该时长即视为失败并恢复常规循环。
某些法系职业可能需要调高此值，尤其是当起手式的第一个动作是硬读条时。

resources.Original:
When you open Wrath with `/wrath`, it will open to the PvE Features tab, instead of the last tab you were on.
Same as always using the `/wrath pve` command to open Wrath.
resources.Translated:
当你使用 `\/wrath` 打开 Wrath 时，将直接打开 PvE 功能标签页，而不是你上次所在的标签页。
等同于始终使用 `\/wrath pve` 命令打开 Wrath。

resources.Original: On (IF trying to troubleshoot an Opener)
resources.Translated: 开启（若正在排查起手式问题）

resources.Original: On (This is essentially turning OFF most of Wrath)
resources.Translated: 开启（这基本上会关闭 Wrath 的大部分功能）
将队外 NPC 加入重新选目标

resources.Original: Allows you to adjust your queue window to any time during the GCD rather than just within the last 0.3-0.5s. Useful if you're not mashing the key or using Auto-Rotation and wish to manually intervene.
resources.Translated: 允许你将技能队列窗口调整到 GCD 期间的任意时间，而不仅限于最后 0.3-0.5 秒内。如果你没有连按按键或使用自动循环，并希望手动调停，此选项会很有用。

resources.Original:
Will lockout combos on your hotbar when detected mechanics that inflict a penalty for using an action is detected (e.g pyretics, acceleration bombs, gazes etc.) has this much time left before resolving.

Some mechanics may override this value.

Set to 0 to disable.
resources.Translated:
当检测到会因使用动作而施加惩罚的机制（例如火刑、促进炸弹、凝视等）距离结算还剩这么多时间时，将锁定热键栏上的连击。

某些机制可能会覆盖此值。

设为 0 以禁用。

resources.Original: This is highly experimental, and may have undesired behaviours. Please be vigilant and report this.
resources.Translated: 此功能高度实验性，可能出现非预期行为。请保持影卫并反馈问题。

resources.Original: (Only used by AST and DNC currently)
resources.Translated: （目前仅占星术士和舞者使用）

resources.Original: Will automatically switch the PvE Features tab to the job you are currently playing, when you switch jobs.
resources.Translated: 当你切换职业时，自动将 PvE 功能标签页切换到当前所玩的职业。

resources.Original:
Will Retarget all Single-Target Healing Actions to the Heal Stack as shown below,
similarly to how Redirect or Reaction would.
This ensures that the target used to check HP% threshold logic for healing actions is the same target that will receive that heal.
resources.Translated:
将所有单体治疗动作重新选目标至下方显示的治疗队列，
类似于重定向或反应的处理方式。
这可确保用于检查治疗动作 HP% 阈值逻辑的目标，与实际接受该治疗的目标一致。

resources.Original: Will print to chat every time you use an action provided by Wrath.
resources.Translated: 每次你使用 Wrath 提供的动作时，都会输出到聊天栏。
4.0-7.0（高于此值可能会严重破坏起手式）

resources.Original:
Unlike the other Default+ Options, this one is not an option in most other Retargeting Plugins.
THIS SHOULD BE USED WITH THE 'RETARGET HEALING ACTIONS' SETTING ABOVE!
resources.Translated:
与其他默认+选项不同，此选项在大多数其他重新选目标插件中并不存在。
此选项应与上方的“重新选目标治疗动作”设置一起使用！

resources.Original:
Will restrict how often Combos will update the Action on your Hotbar.
At 50ms it's not really restrictive, always giving you an up to date action.

If you are looking for some (fairly minor) FPS gains then you can increase this value to make Combos run less often.
This makes your combos less responsive, and perhaps even clips GCDs.
At high values this will clip your GCDs by several seconds or break your rotation altogether.
resources.Translated:
将限制连击更新热键栏技能频率。
50ms 时基本没有限制，始终为你提供最新的技能。

如果你希望获得一些（相当微小的）FPS 提升，可以提高此值以减少连击运行频率。
这会使连击响应变慢，甚至可能卡住 GCD。
数值过高会导致 GCD 卡住数秒，甚至完全打乱循环。

resources.Original: Suppress Set and Unset commands feedback
resources.Translated: 屏蔽设置与取消设置命令的反馈

resources.Original:
This is the order in which Wrath will try to select a healing target. 
If the 'Retarget Healing Actions' option is disabled, that is just the target that will be used for checking the HP threshold to trigger different healing actions to show up in their rotations. 
That means that if your own retargeting solution (Redirect, Reaction, etc) does not match this then Wrath can stick you in a loop of healing the wrong target!!! 
If the 'Retarget Healing Actions' option is enabled, that target is also the one that healing actions will be targeted onto (even when the action does not first check the HP of that target, like the combo's Replaced Action, for example).
resources.Translated:
这是 Wrath 尝试选择治疗目标的顺序。
如果禁用“重定向治疗技能”选项，该目标仅用于检查 HP 阈值，以触发不同治疗技能显示在循环中。
这意味着如果你自己的重定向方案（Redirect、Reaction 等）与此不匹配，Wrath 可能会让你陷入治疗错误目标的循环！！！
如果启用“重定向治疗技能”选项，该目标也是治疗技能的目标（即使该技能不先检查该目标的 HP，例如连击的替换技能）。

resources.Original: This Feature will involve retargeting actions if enabled.
resources.Translated: 启用后，此功能将涉及重定向技能。

resources.Original:
The actions this Feature affects will automatically be
targeted onto the targets in the priority you have configured.
resources.Translated:
此功能影响的技能将自动
按你配置的优先级重定向到目标。

resources.Original:
Using plugins like Redirect or Reaction with configurations
affecting the same actions will Conflict and may cause issues.
resources.Translated:
使用 Redirect 或 Reaction 等插件且配置
影响相同技能时会产生冲突，可能导致问题。

resources.Original:
This is the order in which Wrath will try to select a raise target,
if Retargeting of any Raise Feature is enabled.
resources.Translated:
如果启用了任何复活功能的重定向，
这是 Wrath 尝试选择复活目标的顺序。

resources.Original:
Will generate a debug file on your desktop.
Useful to give developers to help troubleshoot issues.
The same as using the following command: /wrath debug
resources.Translated:
将在你的桌面生成调试文件。
便于提供给开发者帮助排查问题。
等同于使用以下命令：/wrath debug

resources.Original: Category name, Setting name, Internal Name, etc
resources.Translated: 分类名称、设置名称、内部名称等

resources.Original: This tab allows you to customise global settings for Wrath Combo.
resources.Translated: 此标签页允许你自定义 Wrath Combo 的全局设置。

resources.Original:
YOU are responsible for making sure your retargeting solution matches this heal stack!
If it does not then Wrath can get stuck in a loop where X player is checked and needs healing, but Y player is who gets healed!
resources.Translated:
你需要自行确保你的重定向方案与此治疗优先级匹配！
如果不匹配，Wrath 可能会陷入循环：检查的是 X 玩家且需要治疗，但实际被治疗的是 Y 玩家！

attributes.Original: The Wrath user manually elected to revoke your lease.
attributes.Translated: Wrath 用户手动选择撤销你的租约。

attributes.Original: Your plugin was detected as having been disabled, not that you're likely to see this.
attributes.Translated: 检测到你的插件已被禁用，虽然你大概看不到这条消息。

attributes.Original: The Wrath plugin is being disabled.
Your lease was released by IPC call, theoretically this was done by you.
attributes.Translated: 你的租约已通过 IPC 调用释放，理论上这是你自己操作的。

attributes.Original: IPC Services have been disabled remotely. Please see the commit history for /res/ipc_status.txt. https://github.com/PunishXIV/WrathCombo/commits/main/res/ipc_status.txt
attributes.Translated: IPC 服务已被远程禁用。请查看 /res/ipc_status.txt 的提交历史。https://github.com/PunishXIV/WrathCombo/commits/main/res/ipc_status.txt

attributes.Original: Player job has been changed and leases will have to be reapplied.
attributes.Translated: 玩家职业已变更，租约需要重新申请。

attributes.Original: A default value that shouldn't ever be seen.
attributes.Translated: 一个不应出现的默认值。

attributes.Original: The configuration will be set, it is working asynchronously.
attributes.Translated: 配置将被设置，正在异步处理。

attributes.Original: Configuration you are trying to set is already set.
attributes.Translated: 你尝试设置的配置已经设置过了。

attributes.Original: The configuration you are trying to set is not available.
attributes.Translated: 你尝试设置的配置不可用。

attributes.Original: The value you are trying to set is invalid.
